tours.title: Private tours and visits
tours.text: Private journeys to iconic places with clear configuration and attentive service from departure to return.

panel.title: Choose your tour
panel.text: First select the route you are interested in. Then you can configure passengers, pickup, date, time and, where applicable, guide and language.
panel.pickupHelp: The pickup point validates operational feasibility, but does not change the price.
panel.emptyStateText: First choose an option from the catalog to see its configuration and final price.
panel.changeTourConfirm: If you change the tour, we will review the current configuration and only compatible data will be kept. Do you want to continue?

teotihuacan.title: Teotihuacan Pyramids
teotihuacan.description: Discover Teotihuacan in a private experience with round-trip transfer, tickets included, and a visit at your own pace.

teotihuacan_basilica.title: Teotihuacan Pyramids + Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe
teotihuacan_basilica.description: Discover Teotihuacan and the Basilica in a full-day private experience, with round-trip transfer, tickets included, and a well-paced visit.
teotihuacan_basilica.imageAlt: Teotihuacan Pyramids and Basilica of Guadalupe

xochimilco_coyoacan.title: Xochimilco + Coyoacán
xochimilco_coyoacan.description: Enjoy Xochimilco and Coyoacán in a private journey with round-trip transfer, designed to experience two of Mexico City’s most iconic places with calm and comfort.

cholula_puebla.title: Cholula + Puebla
cholula_puebla.description: Explore Cholula and Puebla in a full-day private experience, with transfer from Mexico City and enough time to enjoy the visit at your own pace.

san_miguel_allende.title: San Miguel de Allende
san_miguel_allende.description: Discover San Miguel de Allende in a private journey with transfer from Mexico City, designed to enjoy the visit comfortably and without unnecessary rush.
